resources.string: This video is DV-only (Profile 5) — it has no compatible HDR/SDR base layer. Removing the Dolby Vision layer is not possible without a very slow full conversion, so colors will look wrong (purple/green tint) on this TV if played as-is.
Choose the real video player that DV Strip Player should forward media to.
Always use live proxy (never pre-process to a temp file)

How it works:
• No Dolby Vision → forwarded untouched
• DV Profile 7/8 (hybrid) → DV removed, clean HDR10 output
• DV Profile 5 (DV-only) → warning shown (lossless removal impossible)

Streams and large files are cleaned on the fly through a local proxy (seeking may be limited in proxy mode).
